name: Pixel Card
description: Interactive card with synchronized harmonic pixel matrix, cursor proximity excitation, and 3D perspective tilt.
summary: An interactive card primitive combining a GPU-accelerated sub-pixel Retina 2D canvas matrix with synchronized harmonic wave propagation, pointer proximity excitation, dynamic radial spotlight lighting, and fluid GSAP quickTo 3D perspective tilt.
highlights: Hardware-accelerated sub-pixel 2D canvas with automatic devicePixelRatio Retina scaling
Harmonic wavefront propagation synchronizing pixel emergence directly with cursor coordinates
Dynamic cursor proximity excitation boosting shimmer frequency and amplitude within a 160px aura
Buttery GSAP quickTo 3D perspective rotation (rotationX, rotationY, scale) with zero-cost unmount cleanup
6 curated visual variants (default, blue, yellow, pink, purple, emerald) with themeable token variables
Zero idle CPU/GPU consumption via automatic ticker sleeping when unhovered
anatomy: <div> (3D perspective container with transform-style: preserve-3d and isolate boundary)
<div> (Luminous Border Sheen: masked gradient highlight tracking pointer angle)
<canvas> (Sub-pixel calibrated 2D canvas rendering animated matrix pixels)
<div> (Content Layer: elevated z-10 container with translateZ(26px) for 3D parallax depth)

physics.description: Synchronized trigonometric distance-decay wave propagation and Euler size interpolation running on GSAP 60/120fps display ticker.

accessibility.aria: Supports standard accessibility container attributes; canvas is pointer-events-none and presentation only.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Suppresses 3D perspective tilt and renders static/subtle pixel transitions when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

keyboard.description: Navigates focus to the card container with high-contrast ring outline and center-originated wave ignition.
Triggers card onClick callback if interactive handler is assigned.

recommended: Feature highlight cards and interactive service matrices in high-aesthetic developer landing pages
Interactive pricing plan modules and tier selection cards
Web3, cyber-security, telemetry, and AI agent interface cards
bestPractices: Choose variant colors that match your theme primary accent for brand cohesion
Place interactive child elements inside the card without worrying about canvas interference
Keep grid gap between 5px and 8px for the ideal balance between density and performance

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual color and lighting theme preset for pixels, spotlight, and border glow.

props.name: gap
props.description: Pixel grid spacing pitch in CSS pixels.

props.name: speed
props.description: Animation speed multiplier governing harmonic wave and shimmer frequencies.

props.name: colors
props.description: Comma-separated list of hex or rgb color strings overriding the variant pixel palette.

props.name: enableTilt
props.description: Enables interactive 3D perspective tilt following cursor coordinates.

props.name: maxTilt
props.description: Maximum tilt angle in degrees along X and Y axes.

props.name: enableSpotlight
props.description: Enables dynamic cursor-following radial spotlight glow.

props.name: spotlightColor
props.description: Custom CSS color for the radial spotlight glow center.

props.name: enableGlare
props.description: Enables diagonal holographic sheen reflection wash across the card surface.

props.name: noFocus
props.description: Disables keyboard focusability and focus outline.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes to customize card dimensions, borders, and paddings.

props.name: children
props.description: Interactive card content, headlines, telemetry, or badges elevated in 3D parallax space.
